text:
Maya (Finance): putting this thread up — Cypress AI (acct ID CYP-4432) got an automatic hold after ACH returned R07, invoice #INV-2026-88 for $24,600 is outstanding. collections-bot: hold placed by policy 'auto-return-hold' at 2099991200.
Daniel (Payments): saw the ACH return, bank noted 'account closed'. we retried yesterday, declined again.
Samir (Account Exec): customer PM says they wired a partial today for $10k but haven't sent remittance. asked for service to be resumed for an ongoing demo.
Maya (Finance): we can consider a temporary clearance if they sign a payment plan + provide proof of wire. need legal ok for waiving late fee or making an exception.
Lucy (Ops): to restore app access we need explicit finance approval + ticket to oncall so infra can unflag the org. restoration window is usually 24h after approval.
Samir (Account Exec): customer offered a 30-day split: $10k wired today, remaining $14.6k in two installments (7.3k each) on days 15 and 30. they included a scanned wire receipt (screenshot).
Maya (Finance): can you upload the wire receipt to the billing portal and send txn id? we'll need bank trace. if it's real, we can do a one-time grace lift pending receipt of installment 1.
Daniel (Payments): note — if we accept the plan we should mark invoice with payment plan code 'PP-CYP-01' and set due dates: 2099991234 + 15d and +30d. also set automated reminders.
Carl (Legal): quick read: we can approve conditional clearance if customer signs the standard Collections Payment Agreement (CPA) template and we keep late fees intact (no waive) unless exec sign-off. attaching template link: https://redwood.internal/legal/templates/collections-cpa-v2
Samir (Account Exec): pinging customer for signed CPA and transaction ID. expecting ETA 4h.
Maya (Finance): ok — action plan: 1) Samir gets signed CPA + bank trace. 2) Daniel posts payment plan code and schedules reminders. 3) Carl confirms no additional concessions. 4) Lucy queues restore after step 1 and confirmation from finance.
Lucy (Ops): noted. I'll prep the unflag runbook and tag infra-oncall once we get green.
collections-bot: reminder scheduled: follow-up email to customer in 48h if installment not received.
Daniel (Payments): FYI — if wire fails to clear within 5 business days, we'll escalate to 'escalate-legal' flow. code snippet for our internal ledger tag: `UPDATE invoices SET plan_code='PP-CYP-01', next_due='2099991234+15d' WHERE invoice_id='INV-2026-88';`
Maya (Finance): approving conditional clearance contingent on signed CPA and bank trace. Samir please post updates here. :thumbsup:
Samir (Account Exec): will do, thanks. I'm adding the customer contact: laura@cypress.ai. I'll paste signed doc and tx id when I have it.
Carl (Legal): once doc's in, I can do a 1hr turnaround on standard CPA.
Maya (Finance): if they try to dispute the remaining balance after plan completes, route to finance with supporting usage logs. keep this thread alive for audit.
Samir (Account Exec): update — customer uploaded signed CPA and a wire reference: TRACE-774511. asked to restore immediately.
Daniel (Payments): I see TRACE-774511 in our bank's incoming wires — amount shows $10,000 posted at 2099991400.
Maya (Finance): received. I authorize ops to start restore. Lucy please proceed and confirm when access back.
Lucy (Ops): starting unflag now, pinging infra-oncall @infra-oncall. ETA for full restore ~40m.
Lucy (Ops): restore complete, services back for CYP-4432. verified demo endpoints reachable.
Samir (Account Exec): customer confirmed demo working and is very grateful. signing up for additional seats.
Maya (Finance): closing loop — payment plan set 'PP-CYP-01', reminders scheduled. leaving invoice open until full payment, but hold lifted. logging thread for audit. :white_check_mark:
collections-bot: thread marked 'conditional-clearance' and archived in collections queue.
